title: sesleria uliginosa f. micrantha
intro: Sesleria uliginosa f. micrantha, commonly known as Dwarf Sesleria, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This perennial grass is native to Europe and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Sesleria uliginosa f. micrantha include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiseptic and antiviral effects, and provide relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
